about.heading: About us
about.paragraph1: At Kod & Design we build digital products – everything from landing pages and company websites to complex SaaS applications with authentication, databases and advanced business logic. Regardless of project size, we work closely with you to understand your business and deliver something that actually solves your problem.
about.paragraph2: We work across the full stack with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL. Clear communication, realistic scope and delivering what we promise – that's the core principle behind everything we do.
about.paragraph3: Beyond code, we offer graphic design: logos, visual identity, print materials and social media graphics. A cohesive visual identity makes all the difference, and we can help with everything from the first sketch to the final files.

pricing.subtitle: We tailor the setup to your needs. Every project starts with a free consultation where we put together a quote.

hosting.description: We build the project and manage hosting for you – Vercel, S3 bucket for media and similar – all on your own account and billed to you. You only pay the actual costs plus a small administration fee.

items.title: Advance payment
items.text: 30–50% of the project price is invoiced at project start. The remaining amount is invoiced upon delivery.

items.title: Changes outside scope
items.text: Changes beyond the agreed scope are billed hourly. We always inform you before starting any additional work.

items.title: Ownership
items.text: Ownership of the code transfers to you upon full payment. Until then, Kod & Design owns the code.

items.title: Cancellation
items.text: If the project is cancelled, work completed up to that point is billed at the agreed hourly rate.

items.title: Payment
items.text: Payment terms are 30 days net unless otherwise agreed.

items.title: GDPR
items.text: If we process personal data on your behalf, we sign a data processing agreement (DPA).
